failure.title: Performance web started before its owned coach corpus existed
failure.note: The third fresh-owned smoke retained the unhealthy production-web wait, redacted service logs, structured command failure, safe teardown transcript, and empty container, volume, and network inventories. The no-demo migration succeeded, no performance corpus or measured gate began, and all project resources were removed.
failure.diagnosis: After demo seeding was removed, the runner still started and health-checked the production web container before inserting its owned corpus. Production composition correctly refuses synthetic-only startup when the canonical coach is absent, so readiness remained 503 until Compose's bounded wait marked the container unhealthy.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
